tools.name: analyze_repo
tools.description: Analyze a local path or GitHub repo/url with CodeEvolve. Writes report.json (and optional deliberation pack). Use this first before provenance_* tools when parsing an unfamiliar codebase.

repo.description: Local path, owner/name, or https://github.com/… URL

out.description: Where to write report.json (default: .codeevolve/report.json under cwd or repo)

pack_out.description: Optional path to write deliberation pack JSON

path.description: Optional path focus included in returned pack

tools.name: provenance_pack
tools.description: Build a deliberation pack from a CodeEvolve report.json. Returns frames with claim→evidence→falsifier for agent deliberation.

tools.name: provenance_expand_frame
tools.description: Expand a deliberation frame id with evidence records, chain, and timeline.

tools.name: provenance_path_pack
tools.description: Path-centric provenance for a file/dir: lineage, episodes, blast, symbols, frames. Use before editing a hotspot.

tools.name: provenance_resolve
tools.description: Walk evidence links from a record or frame id.

tools.name: provenance_timeline
tools.description: Chronological provenance slice (state samples + lifecycle events).
